meta.name: init-next-logging
meta.description: Initializes production-ready logging for a Next.js project using Pino + pino-roll with file output and log rotation. Use when setting up a new Next.js project, adding logging infrastructure, or when the user asks to initialize Next.js logging with log rotation and file output.

copy.tagline: 初始化 Next.js 项目的生产级日志,支持文件输出与轮转
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在搭建 Next.js 项目并需要可靠的日志系统
copy.tagline_en: Initialize production-ready logging for Next.js with file output and rotation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're setting up a Next.js project and need solid logging

howto.what: Claude 会在 Next.js 项目中创建一套日志系统：安装 Pino 和 pino-roll，生成记录日志的代码模块、给日志加上请求ID等上下文、捕获未处理异常、修改配置使日志写入文件并按大小或时间轮转。
howto.when: 当用户搭建新的 Next.js 项目、要求添加日志基础设施，或要求初始化带文件输出和轮转的 Next.js 日志时触发。

say.note: 会安装依赖、创建 logger 和日志目录

say.text: 给我的 Next.js 加一个带请求ID和耗时的日志包装器

say.text: 在 Next.js 里配置全局异常捕获并写入日志

howto.what_en: Claude will set up a logging system in a Next.js project: install Pino and pino-roll, create logging modules, attach request context like requestId, capture unhandled exceptions, and configure file output with rotation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user starts a new Next.js project, asks to add logging infrastructure, or requests initializing Next.js logging with file output and rotation.

say_en.text: Initialize Pino logging for my Next.js project with daily file rotation.
say_en.note: Installs dependencies, creates logger and logs directory.

say_en.text: Add a request logger wrapper with requestId and duration to my Next.js app.
say_en.note: Creates lib/withLogger.ts to inject context automatically.

say_en.text: Configure global exception catching in Next.js and write errors to the log.
say_en.note: Creates or merges instrumentation.ts to listen for crashes.
